t: A 45 minute no-equipment activity where pairs act as a robot and a programmer.
steps: Find the Unplugged Human Robots activity from Purdue 4-H.
Read the steps and the discussion questions.
Prepare an open space where students can move.
Print the companion worksheet if you want to use it.
Pair students and explain the robot and programmer roles.
Run one round, then swap roles.
Try an extension such as an obstacle course.
